results.notes: SET-LEVEL EXCEPTION (rule 5): treatment_mean and control_mean retain the extraction's raw arm totals of submissions containing 'sprinkler', not participant-level averages or percentages. Difference is treatment minus control in submissions; positive means more keyword convergence. There is one observed set per arm. Participant SDs, difference_se, se_type and n_clusters are null because a participant HC2 regression would estimate a different, binary-rate outcome. No HC2 SE is assigned to the raw set-count difference. Reproduction: main PDF p. 1 (printed p. 1107) gives the keyword totals; Supplementary Table 1, PDF pp. 3-4, gives the person counts. Headerless UTF-8 pool CSVs were read in their posted order, column 0, with outer whitespace stripped, as in the notebook. Each submission is counted once if its lowercase text includes 'sprinkler', including the plural 'sprinklers'. The notebook does not give a separate keyword routine; this transparent text rule reproduces every printed keyword count exactly. Case-sensitive matching misses one ChatGPT idea, and singular-only whole-word matching misses one human idea. Treatment source: exp_2a/gpt_ideas.csv; control source: exp_2a/human_ideas.csv. Both pools link to distinct participant rows in exp_2a/Exp2A.main.full.csv through Condition and idea_text_raw. The single ChatGPT linkage discrepancy is a mojibake right apostrophe; normalization was used only for linkage, not keyword counting. Original Exp2A exclusions were independently reconstructed from Exp2A.main.qualtrics.csv using Exp2A.analyze.Rmd as text: valid PROLIFIC_PID and mturk lengths >=13, Finished=1, nonmissing age and gender_f, attention_check_2=2, and the six explicitly listed nonsensical-response IDs removed. Counts after these steps are 414, 298, 297, 291. The retained worker and response ID sets exactly match the posted 291-person reanalysis file; all posted creativity-rating composites are nonmissing. No further exclusions or averaging across ratings were used for these lexical counts. All read deposit files passed the manifest SHA-256 and byte-size checks. Between-person randomization; first_round is inapplicable.

It is a set-level statistic and has no participant-level SD or HC2 SE under rule 5. Exact reproduction requires https://tfhub.dev/google/universal-sentence-encoder/4 (analysis.ipynb, cell 0). The supplied reanalysis CSVs contain idea texts and survey/rating data, but no saved embeddings, similarity scores, or model weights; all notebook outputs are empty. This Python environment lacks tensorflow, tensorflow_hub. The exact encoder was therefore not available for recomputation under the restriction to write only B.py and B.json. No substitute encoder or values inferred from the paper were used. Mapped one submission per distinct workerId/ResponseId: treatment exp_1/chatbot_ideas.csv (103 people), control exp_1/control_ideas.csv (130 people). Both arm counts match the printed counts exactly. No outcome statistics were computed because the outcome could not be reproduced first.
